35.name: Still Water
35.why: A lake at evening, so quiet you can hear the guitar from the far shore.

35.name: Evening Sea
35.why: The sea goes this color when the day is tired and nobody has much left to say.

35.name: Arbat Dusk
35.why: The Arbat at nightfall, lamps not yet lit, somebody singing behind an open window.

36.name: Barley Field
36.why: The field at the end of a long day, the harvest in and the people walking home slowly.

36.name: Late Light
36.why: The sun low over the roofs, a light that asks nothing of anyone.

36.name: Courtyard Lamp
36.why: The one lamp still burning in the courtyard, where the neighbors leave their windows open.
